name: ascendant
description: Decides what to build. Then builds it.

peerDependencyRules.//: drizzle-orm declares every driver as an optional peer, so adding @electric-sql/pglite made pnpm resolve a SECOND drizzle-orm instance for @ascendant/db. Two copies means two structurally identical but nominally distinct SQL<> types, and every query passed across a package boundary fails to typecheck. Ignoring the peer keeps one instance for the whole workspace; the driver is imported directly by db/src/local.ts either way.
